mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 68 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park under a waning crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 62 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, a Madison resident, Halla Nelson, was arrested on September 4 for a 2019 incident involving the sexual assault of a student. Also, expect traffic shifts on Highway M starting the week of September 7 for ongoing construction, and look forward to the upcoming Military Ridge State Trail paving project.

Today, you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have plenty of options with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and more events following throughout the week including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on September 9.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student, resulting in an arrest on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The store is currently open but will be closing in 52 minutes, so there is still time to grab a treat before they close for the night.
